#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Continuously copy complete, non-empty FIFO records to received.txt."""

import os
import signal


class Shutdown(Exception):
    """Raised to leave a blocking FIFO operation on SIGTERM."""


def request_shutdown(signum, frame):
    raise Shutdown()


base = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
fifo_path = os.path.join(base, "jobs.fifo")
target_path = os.path.join(base, "received.txt")
pending = b""

signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, request_shutdown)

try:
    with open(target_path, "ab", buffering=0) as target:
        while True:
            fd = os.open(fifo_path, os.O_RDONLY)
            try:
                while True:
                    chunk = os.read(fd, 65536)
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    pending += chunk
                    records = pending.split(b"\n")
                    pending = records.pop()
                    wrote = False
                    for record in records:
                        if record:
                            target.write(record + b"\n")
                            wrote = True
                    if wrote:
                        os.fsync(target.fileno())
            finally:
                os.close(fd)
except (Shutdown, KeyboardInterrupt):
    pass
PY_EOF

command:
set -eu
pid=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value fifo-consumer.service)
set -- $(cat /proc/$pid/stat)
cpu_before=$((${14}+${15}))
wchan_before=$(cat /proc/$pid/wchan)
sleep 3
set -- $(cat /proc/$pid/stat)
cpu_after=$((${14}+${15}))
wchan_after=$(cat /proc/$pid/wchan)
printf 'idle PID=%s cpu_ticks_before=%s cpu_ticks_after=%s delta=%s wchan_before=%s wchan_after=%s\n' "$pid" "$cpu_before" "$cpu_after" "$((cpu_after-cpu_before))" "$wchan_before" "$wchan_after"
printf 'after-reboot-producer-a\n' > /srv/legacy2/fifo-worker-reconnection/jobs.fifo
printf '\nafter-reboot-producer-b\n' > /srv/legacy2/fifo-worker-reconnection/jobs.fifo
sleep 1
pid_after=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value fifo-consumer.service)
printf 'producer PID before=%s after=%s NRestarts=%s\n' "$pid" "$pid_after" "$(systemctl show -p NRestarts --value fifo-consumer.service)"
tail -n 4 /srv/legacy2/fifo-worker-reconnection/received.txt
